## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] TypeScript check passed (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Formatting check passed (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] Production build passed (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Affected browser workflows tested with **synthetic local data**
- [ ] Desktop/mobile states reviewed if UI changed
- [ ] Docs/screenshots updated if relevant

## Visual evidence (UI changes)

Before/after screenshots or screen recordings, if applicable.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No passwords, session tokens, `.env` files or personal health data committed
- [ ] Existing authentication and API contracts preserved (or coordinated with backend)
